results.title: 运行时 auto 引用绕过 AutoReadAdmission 准入条件
results.reason: Runtime now requires a current source pin, a unique exact message match, no owned conflict group, known owner time and at most three automatic fragments.

results.title: 运行中 Enter 排队的 auto-read 跳过发送前准入
results.reason: Normal Enter calls handleInterventionSend(queue), which awaits routeKnowledgeForMessage before completeSend. Electron dev5 recorded routeContext(auto-read) for the queued question and an auto_attach response; its dispatch failure came from using interface availability as long-task ownership, which is separately fixed.

results.reason: knowledgeIdentity includes the full normalized query; the identity effect aborts and increments the epoch. routeKnowledgeForMessage compares both epoch and identity before state writes.
